description_en: Queries all cluster information by using paging and supports filtering by conditions
description_zh: 分页查询所有集群信息，支持按条件筛选
kebab_example: aliyun vs list-hives --hive-id g-xxxx --name test001 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --start-time 2025-05-14T15:20:37+08:00 --end-time 2025-05-14T15:20:37+08:00 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHives

parameters.help_en: The cloud application service group ID
parameters.name: hive_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the query list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询列表的页码。起始值为1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值为100行。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The time range filter parameter. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 时间区间筛选参数。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time
